column1: =In this banner, if you do not obtain an Elite Weapon within 50 consecutive accesses, the drop rate of obtaining an Elite Weapon will increase, and every 70 accesses guarantees an Elite Weapon.

column1: # ============ [Mystery Box Description] ============
=[Mystery Box Description]
column2: [Deskripsi Mystery Box]

column1: =A mysterious electronic device located on the Elmo, decorated in a vibrant style in order to tempt people to try it out.
column2: Perangkat elektronik misterius di Elmo, dihias dengan gaya mencolok supaya orang tergoda mencobanya.

column1: =You can spend Wishing Coins to win various items.
column2: Kamu bisa memakai Wishing Coins untuk memenangkan berbagai item.

column1: =- Mystery Box Detailed Rules
column2: - Aturan Rinci Mystery Box

column1: =Whenever you make a draw from the Mystery Box, there is a chance to win a standard, rare, or limited prize.
column2: Tiap kali menarik dari Mystery Box, ada peluang memenangkan hadiah standar, rare, atau terbatas.

column1: =Detailed probabilities are as follows:
column2: Probabilitas rincinya sebagai berikut:

column1: =Whenever a draw is made from the Mystery Box, the combined probability of winning a limited prize is [VAL1].
column2: Tiap kali menarik dari Mystery Box, probabilitas gabungan memenangkan hadiah terbatas adalah [VAL1].

column1: =When a limited prize is won, you are guaranteed to obtain 1 elite Doll Peritya.
column2: Saat hadiah terbatas dimenangkan, kamu dijamin mendapat 1 Doll elite Peritya.

column1: =Whenever a draw is made from the Mystery Box, the combined probability of winning a rare prize is [VAL2].
column2: Tiap kali menarik dari Mystery Box, probabilitas gabungan memenangkan hadiah rare adalah [VAL2].

column1: =When a rare prize is won, there is a random and equal chance to obtain one of the following Standard weapons: [Hare], [.50 Nemesis], [.380 Curva], [Vepr-12], [OTs-14], [MP7H1], and [Pecheneg-SP].
column2: Saat hadiah rare dimenangkan, ada peluang acak dan setara untuk mendapat salah satu senjata Standard berikut: [Hare], [.50 Nemesis], [.380 Curva], [Vepr-12], [OTs-14], [MP7H1], dan [Pecheneg-SP].

column1: =Whenever a draw is made from the Mystery Box, the combined probability of winning a standard prize is [VAL3].
column2: Tiap kali menarik dari Mystery Box, probabilitas gabungan memenangkan hadiah standar adalah [VAL3].

column1: =Among them, the probability of obtaining [Sardis Gold ×6,000] is [VAL4], the probability of obtaining [Combat Report ×6,000] is [VAL5], the probability of obtaining [Analysis Blueprint ×6,000] is [VAL6], the probability of obtaining [Stock Boost Bar T1 ×8] is [VAL7], the probability of obtaining [Stock Boost Bar T2 ×2] is [VAL8], the probability of obtaining [Stock Boost Bar T3 ×1] is [VAL9], the probability of obtaining [Transcription Conductor III ×8] is [VAL10], the probability of obtaining [Transcription Conductor IV ×7] is [VAL11], the probability of obtaining [Transcription Conductor V ×4] is [VAL12], the probability of obtaining [Transcription Conductor VI ×3] is [VAL13], and the probability of obtaining [Standard Memory Stick ×3] is [VAL14].
column2: Di antaranya, probabilitas mendapat [Sardis Gold ×6,000] adalah [VAL4], [Combat Report ×6,000] adalah [VAL5], [Analysis Blueprint ×6,000] adalah [VAL6], [Stock Boost Bar T1 ×8] adalah [VAL7], [Stock Boost Bar T2 ×2] adalah [VAL8], [Stock Boost Bar T3 ×1] adalah [VAL9], [Transcription Conductor III ×8] adalah [VAL10], [Transcription Conductor IV ×7] adalah [VAL11], [Transcription Conductor V ×4] adalah [VAL12], [Transcription Conductor VI ×3] adalah [VAL13], dan [Standard Memory Stick ×3] adalah [VAL14].

column1: =As the Mystery Box remains a prototype and cannot handle frequent usage, the rewards from it can only be collected up to a maximum of 100 times per week.
column2: Karena Mystery Box masih prototipe dan tidak tahan pemakaian sering, hadiahnya hanya bisa diambil maksimal 100 kali per minggu.

column1: # ============ [Recreation System Explanation] ============
=[Recreation System Explanation]
column2: [Penjelasan Sistem Rekreasi]

column1: =Various activities on the Crew Deck generate Recreation Points.
column2: Berbagai aktivitas di Crew Deck menghasilkan Recreation Points.

column1: =The detailed means of acquiring Recreation Points are as follows:
column2: Cara mendapatkan Recreation Points secara rinci sebagai berikut:

column1: =- [40 Recreation Points]: Dreamscape, Delicious Cuisine, Tea Time
column2: - [40 Recreation Points]: Dreamscape, Delicious Cuisine, Tea Time

column1: =- [20 Recreation Points]: Dulcet Whisper, triggering Interludes, upgrading dishes, upgrading drinks at the Counter, unlocking Private Meeting logs, building on the Crew Deck
column2: - [20 Recreation Points]: Dulcet Whisper, memicu Interludes, meningkatkan hidangan, meningkatkan minuman di Counter, membuka log Private Meeting, membangun di Crew Deck

column1: =- [10 Recreation Points]: Playing Crimson Arcade games, gaining Affinity points
column2: - [10 Recreation Points]: Main game Crimson Arcade, mendapat poin Affinity

column1: =- [5 Recreation Points]: Making edits on the Crew Deck, daily conversations
column2: - [5 Recreation Points]: Melakukan edit di Crew Deck, percakapan harian

column1: =The first interaction each day grants additional [Mood Score] and [Merkle Leaves].
column2: Interaksi pertama tiap hari memberi tambahan [Mood Score] dan [Merkle Leaves].

column1: =Each week, you can unlock [Recreation Node] rewards by gaining [Recreation Points].
column2: Tiap minggu, kamu bisa membuka hadiah [Recreation Node] dengan mengumpulkan [Recreation Points].

column1: =A maximum of 100 Recreation Points can be gained per day.
column2: Maksimal 100 Recreation Points bisa didapat per hari.

column1: # ============ [Intro] Light and Shadow Agreement ============
=<size=20>An investment agreement provided by Poludnitsa and Saga.
column2: <size=20>Perjanjian investasi yang disediakan Poludnitsa dan Saga.

column1: =Once signed, you can obtain massive returns for a very small cost.
column2: Setelah ditandatangani, kamu bisa mendapat imbal hasil besar dengan biaya sangat kecil.

column1: =Of course, if you are willing to make additional investments, high-value rebates await you.
column2: Tentu saja, kalau kamu bersedia berinvestasi lebih, rabat bernilai tinggi menantimu.

column1: =Once activated, you will receive special assistance from the Underground Brokers for a period of time.
column2: Setelah diaktifkan, kamu akan menerima bantuan khusus dari Underground Brokers untuk jangka waktu tertentu.

column1: ="Light and Shadow Agreement" Event Period: <color=#F26C1C>2026/4/28 08:00:00 - 2026/5/11 04:59:59</color>.
column2: Periode Event "Light and Shadow Agreement": <color=#F26C1C>2026/4/28 08:00:00 - 2026/5/11 04:59:59</color>.

column1: =By accumulating logins for specified days during the event, players can claim free rewards and pay to unlock the "Advanced Incentive" rewards.
column2: Dengan mengumpulkan login pada hari-hari tertentu selama event, pemain bisa mengklaim hadiah gratis dan membayar untuk membuka hadiah "Advanced Incentive".

column1: =After unlocking the "Advanced Incentive," the event end time will be extended to <color=#F26C1C>2026/5/18 04:59:59</color>.
column2: Setelah membuka "Advanced Incentive," waktu berakhir event diperpanjang sampai <color=#F26C1C>2026/5/18 04:59:59</color>.

column1: =The cumulative status will update daily at 5:00.
column2: Status kumulatif diperbarui tiap hari pukul 5:00.

column1: =After the event ends, the interface will close, and any unlocked rewards will automatically become invalid and will not be refunded.
column2: Setelah event berakhir, antarmukanya ditutup, dan hadiah yang tidak terbuka otomatis hangus serta tidak dikembalikan.

column1: =After the event ends (calculated according to the extended time), unlocked but unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.
column2: Setelah event berakhir (dihitung berdasarkan waktu yang diperpanjang), hadiah yang sudah terbuka tapi belum diklaim akan dikirim lewat surat.

column1: =The mail will be automatically deleted after 15 days.</size>
column2: Surat akan terhapus otomatis setelah 15 hari.</size>

column1: # ============ Harvest Coins / Dispatch Plan ============
=<size=20>Complete missions to obtain [Harvest Coins].
column2: <size=20>Selesaikan misi untuk mendapat [Harvest Coins].

column1: =[Harvest Coins] can be used to draw limited prizes and they can also be used to draw [Dispatch Vouchers] to have the dev team perform various challenges!</size>
column2: [Harvest Coins] bisa dipakai untuk menarik hadiah terbatas dan juga menarik [Dispatch Vouchers] agar tim dev menjalankan berbagai tantangan!</size>

column1: =While missions are active, you can complete missions to obtain [Harvest Coins].
column2: Selama misi aktif, kamu bisa menyelesaikan misi untuk mendapat [Harvest Coins].

column1: =You can proceed to the event webpage to use [Harvest Coins] to draw prizes.
column2: Kamu bisa membuka halaman web event untuk memakai [Harvest Coins] menarik hadiah.

column1: =For more details and draw rules, please check the event webpage.
column2: Untuk detail dan aturan penarikan, silakan cek halaman web event.

column1: =For every 1000 [Harvest Coins] Commanders spend, they will automatically gain 1 [Dispatch Voucher].
column2: Tiap 1000 [Harvest Coins] yang dipakai Komandan, otomatis mendapat 1 [Dispatch Voucher].

column1: =[Dispatch Vouchers] can be used to vote in [Dispatch Plan].
column2: [Dispatch Vouchers] bisa dipakai untuk memilih di [Dispatch Plan].

column1: =The dev team will abide by the dispatch suggestions of the Commanders and complete the most voted-for task on the [Dispatch Plan].
column2: Tim dev akan mengikuti usulan para Komandan dan menyelesaikan tugas dengan suara terbanyak di [Dispatch Plan].

column1: =The voting results from [Dispatch Plan] will be computed based on data from all regions around the world.
column2: Hasil pemungutan suara [Dispatch Plan] dihitung berdasarkan data dari semua region di seluruh dunia.

column1: =The results for the [Dispatch Plan] will be updated once per hour.
column2: Hasil [Dispatch Plan] diperbarui sekali tiap jam.

column1: =The popularity score for the [Dispatch Plan] is positively correlated with the number of votes.
column2: Skor popularitas [Dispatch Plan] berkorelasi positif dengan jumlah suara.

column1: =It only reflects the proportion of votes received and does not reflect the actual number of votes received.</size>
column2: Ini hanya mencerminkan proporsi suara yang diterima, bukan jumlah suara sebenarnya.</size>
